svg.title: RGC price point cloud: 500 fictional products
svg.desc: Static projection of the same product records and trait-layer samples as the interactive prototype. This is not a browser screenshot.
svg.text: EXPLORE THE SHAPE OF A PRICING DECISION
500 products. Six traits. Every price has a structure.
Colored points reveal the layers behind each price.
DRAG TO ORBIT · CLICK A POINT TO INSPECT
White anchors = full benchmark. Colored returns = samples within each product’s stacked contributions.
Every layer sums to the benchmark.
Changing the proposal preserves the cloud.
500 FICTIONAL RECORDS · SIX TRAITS · SYNTHETIC PRICE FUNCTION
STATIC GEOMETRY PREVIEW · NOT A BROWSER SCREENSHOT
